title: Work item state.json contract (design §8, §11)
description: Whole state.json contract, including the pre-existing leaseOwner rules. check_work_item_schema in scripts/verify-candidate is the validator. requiredStages ordering/additive-only/justification rules are policy checks (policy.invalid_stages, policy.stage_reduction_forbidden, policy.justification_required) evaluated at verification, not expressible here. Parity is scenario-bound (§11, §13).

requiredStages.description: Explicit additive-only override; must be an ordered subsequence of the vocabulary (enforced as policy.invalid_stages at verification, §8.1).

requiredStagesJustification.description: Required (non-empty) iff the explicit list differs from the policy-derived value; must be absent otherwise (enforced at verification).

leaseOwner.description: Non-empty while status is implementing/verifying; unique across work items; null when unclaimed.

verificationCommands.description: Work-item-specific mandatory verification beyond the repo-wide gauntlet; requirements, not suggestions (design §6.2). Never a pointer to verify-candidate itself.
